verdict.rationale: Discord's developer docs confirm bots can be added to servers/channels via bot tokens, receive real-time events through the Gateway API, and respond via slash commands/interactions — the technical building blocks needed for an AI agent bot that participates when mentioned. However, no evidence explicitly documents mention-detection/response behavior or an AI-agent-specific integration pattern, and no first-party example of an 'AI agent as channel member' is cited. missing for 10: explicit mention-triggered response documentation, AI-agent-specific integration example, hands-on/independent confirmation of this exact workflow.
